Select the state in which the params are overridden
When you don't want the image to be uploaded and uploaded too large, you can use this setting to indirectly restrict it
§7NO: Never override
§7MAX: If the client params is bigger
§7MIN: If the client params is smaller
ALWAYS: Always override

The type shared image use
§7PNG: Commonly used lossless compression format
§7AVIF: Better than PNG

The quality of the image in AVIF format
§7If you want to reduce the packet size and maintain the image quality
§7For high resolution, 50 is recommended
§7For low resolution, 75 is recommended

The speed of turning the image into AVIF format
§7Low speeds can slightly increase the compression ratio
§710 is recommended
§7It is not recommended to set it below 5, it is §lVERY SLOW
Whether the image is lossless in AVIF format
